title: PromptVault
description: Save, search and inject your AI prompts into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more — with one click. Built for power users.
longDescription: Stop retyping the same prompts. Save once. Inject anywhere. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini — one click away.
heroTagline:
Stop retyping the same prompts.
Save once. Inject anywhere.
ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini — one click away.
mockupSubtitle: The extension lives in Chrome's side panel — always one click away, never in the way.
featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to run your AI workflow at full speed.

features.title: ONE-CLICK INJECT
features.desc: Hit INSERT and your prompt lands directly in the chat input — no copy-paste, no friction.

features.title: INSTANT SEARCH
features.desc: Full-text search across all your prompts. Find what you need in milliseconds.

features.title: AI-SCOPED PROMPTS
features.desc: Tag a prompt to a specific AI. It only appears when that AI is selected — keep your vault clean.

features.title: CLOUD SYNC
features.desc: Add the Sync subscription (€1.99/mo) to back up and sync your vault across all your devices automatically.

features.title: CUSTOM AIs
features.desc: Add any AI tool by URL. PromptVault injects into any web-based chat interface.

features.title: 3 THEMES
features.desc: Matrix Green, Dark Mono, Light. Pick your aesthetic — the terminal look is always sharp.

themesSubtitle: Three carefully crafted themes. Switch instantly from the header.

steps.title: INSTALL
steps.desc: Add PromptVault from the Chrome Web Store. One click, no signup required.

steps.title: SAVE
steps.desc: Open the side panel, type a title and your prompt, hit save. Done.

steps.title: INJECT
steps.desc: Navigate to any supported AI, pick your prompt, hit INSERT. It lands instantly.

pricingSubtitle: Free forever locally. Pay once for unlimited prompts. Add sync only if you need it.
